scenarios.name: Restore a saved camera for an active view representation

scenario_steps.name: an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
a copied view representation is active
Autosave Camera is off for the active view
the user chooses Save Current Camera from the active view's Camera View submenu
the user changes the orientation to Top using the orientation control
the user chooses Restore Saved Camera from the active view's Camera View submenu
